leads.title: Decree No. 47,306 - Social Name Card (Carteira de Nome Social)
leads.documents: Creates Social Name Card authorizing trans and travesti individuals to use social names for identification in Minas Gerais
leads.detail: Issued 15 December 2017 by State Governor Fernando Pimentel

leads.title: Supreme Federal Court ruling of 1 March 2018 on gender identity
leads.documents: Rules transgender person has right to change official name and sex by self-declaration without surgery or professional evaluation
leads.detail: Supreme Federal Court of Brazil, 1 March 2018, self-declaration of psychosocial identity

leads.title: Uberaba unisex restroom ban - Court of Justice of Minas Gerais 2024 ruling
leads.documents: Documents enforcement attempt banning unisex restrooms and its judicial strike-down after Public Defender challenge
leads.detail: Bill approved 12 September 2022 by 11-6 vote; enacted 7 October 2022 after Mayor Elisa Araujo (Solidariedade) neither vetoed nor signed, published in Official Gazette; lawsuit filed 2023 by Public Defender's Office of Minas Gerais; struck down 2024

leads.title: Belo Horizonte religious-institutions bathroom law - Court of Justice injunction August 2025
leads.documents: Documents law authorizing religious institutions to prohibit transgender people from using restrooms matching gender identity and its suspension
leads.detail: Approved 4 October 2023 by 26-13-1 vote; signed 20 November 2023 by Mayor Fuad Noman (PSD); struck down by preliminary injunction from Court of Justice in August 2025

leads.title: Court of Justice of Minas Gerais August 2026 Contagem shopping mall decision
leads.documents: Documented incident of trans woman denied access to women's restroom in 2019, ordered 2,000 reais compensation
leads.detail: Incident 2019 in Contagem; guard told woman to 'use common sense' and 'think about mothers with children,' asked for document proving 'sex change'; initial Contagem court rejected claim; TJMG ruled in her favor August 2026

leads.title: Public Defender's Office of Minas Gerais - Pride Month non-binary documentation initiatives / Tai Barreto case
leads.documents: Documents rights machinery for non-binary name and gender marker changes and ongoing challenges
leads.detail: Free initiatives since 2023 during Pride Month; Tai Barreto changed name and gender 29 May 2025 via lawsuit filed by Public Defender's Office with Court of Justice of Minas Gerais

leads.title: Federal University of Minas Gerais + Public Prosecutor's Office study released 1 July 2024
leads.documents: Government-academic report: 60% of deaths involving trans people and travestis in state resulted from violence; 74% victims Black or Pardo
leads.detail: Study by Federal University of Minas Gerais in partnership with state Public Prosecutor's Office, released 1 July 2024

leads.title: Associacao Nacional de Travestis e Transexuais (ANTRA) 2025 data
leads.documents: Human-rights report ranking Minas Gerais alongside Ceara as state with highest number of murders of trans people and travestis in 2025

leads.title: Grupo Gay da Bahia violence data for 2017
leads.documents: Human-rights report ranking Minas Gerais as second-highest state for cases of violence against LGBTQ people in 2017
leads.detail: Grupo Gay da Bahia data for 2017

leads.title: Coacci, Thiago (2019) 'Movimento trans em Belo Horizonte' - Cadernos Pagu (55)
leads.documents: Academic mapping of transgender movement history and present in Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais
leads.detail: Cadernos Pagu (in Portuguese) (55). doi:10.1590/18094449201900550018. ISSN 1809-4449. Archived 28 November 2023; listed under Further reading
